nodes.label: App Icon (icon.png)
nodes.description: Round app icon: cartoon white hen with red comb/bandana holding a dark weapon, on a green circular badge with thick dark outline; flat cartoon style suitable for Windows/Android launcher icons

nodes.label: Armed Chicken Mascot
nodes.rationale: A combat-ready hen visually encodes the game's theme (battle chicken coop) in a single recognizable character

nodes.label: Flat Cartoon Circular Badge Style
nodes.rationale: Circular green badge with bold outlines stays legible at small launcher sizes on Windows and Android

nodes.label: SIL Open Font License 1.1
nodes.rationale: Fonts may be bundled and redistributed with software as long as they are not sold by themselves.

nodes.label: Rubik Bubbles font (Rubik Filtered Project Authors, 2020)
nodes.norm_label: rubik bubbles font (rubik filtered project authors, 2020)

nodes.label: Kuriatnyk App Icon (512px)
nodes.description: 512x512 application icon: flat cartoon white chicken with red comb and red bandana holding a dark gun, standing on a green circular badge with a bold dark outline. Used as the Windows/Android launcher icon for the Battle Chicken Coop game.

nodes.label: Armed Chicken Mascot
nodes.rationale: The bandana-wearing chicken holding a weapon conveys the game's combat/shooter theme (Battle Chicken Coop, Soul Knight-style mode) in a single readable silhouette.

nodes.label: Flat Cartoon Icon Style
nodes.rationale: Thick dark outlines, limited palette (green, white, red, orange) and a circular badge keep the icon legible at small launcher sizes on both Windows and Android.

nodes.label: SkiaSharp Rendering
nodes.rationale: Renders battlefield, characters and HUD; wrapped by Ctx.cs canvas-style API

nodes.label: Account Progression (PTS, Profile)
nodes.rationale: In-game name, avatars, account level earned with PTS, statistics, several local accounts per device; implemented in Meta.cs

nodes.label: Android Launcher and APK Build
nodes.rationale: Built via build-android.ps1, debug-signed APK in dist/android, landscape only

nodes.label: Avalonia 11.3
nodes.rationale: Chosen for shared UI across desktop and mobile

nodes.label: Bird Statue Shrine
nodes.rationale: Pay pivchiki to replace your ultimate with any hero's ultimate or Reinforcements for the rest of the run

nodes.label: Chests, Cards and Upgrades
nodes.rationale: Hero and weapon cards, upgrades to level 10; chest odds always shown (transparency)

nodes.label: x2 Crit Chance
nodes.rationale: 5% for everyone, 12% for snipers

nodes.label: Daily Shop Card Packs
nodes.rationale: Two random card packs a day refreshed at 00:00 UTC; implemented in Offers.cs

nodes.label: Windows Desktop Launcher
nodes.rationale: Publishable as a self-contained single-file exe

nodes.label: Endless Battle Mode
nodes.rationale: Growing waves, boss every 5 waves, rewards per wave (grain, tokens, golden eggs, Mega chests)

nodes.label: Hamster Shaker Boss
nodes.rationale: Boss with earthquake attacks; appears in Endless battle and as optional boss in Soul Knight; implemented in Hamster.cs

nodes.label: Heroes and Classes
nodes.rationale: 9 heroes in 4 classes (Assault, Tank, Sniper, Medic), each with an ultimate and two passives

nodes.label: 8-Language Localization
nodes.rationale: Switchable on the fly; dictionaries in Assets/Lang/*.json keyed by the Russian source strings

nodes.label: Local Multiplayer Co-op
nodes.rationale: Up to 4 players over LAN or Radmin VPN/Hamachi; host-authoritative; enemy health scales 150/250/400% for 2/3/4 players; downed hero revives after 15s; network server option locked until own servers exist

nodes.label: nutze (Arthur Dyakonov)
nodes.rationale: Creator, game design, testing

nodes.label: Achievements, Quests and Battle Pass
nodes.rationale: Three daily quests, one weekly quest, monthly battle pass with free track and premium for 299 golden eggs

nodes.label: Rivers, Random Bridges and Piranhas
nodes.rationale: Bridges and rotten bridges placed randomly each match, always at least one solid bridge per river to guarantee passability; implemented in World.cs

nodes.label: Rubik and Rubik Bubbles Fonts
nodes.rationale: SIL OFL 1.1 licensed, bundled in src/Kuriatnyk/Assets/Fonts

nodes.label: Save Files
nodes.rationale: save.json, save-<id>.json per extra account and settings.json in %LOCALAPPDATA%\BoevoyKuryatnik; KUR_DATA_DIR overrides folder so tests do not touch real progress

nodes.label: Soul Knight Passives
nodes.rationale: Choice of three passives at the portal between levels; +1 weapon slot appears only once

nodes.label: Soul Knight Arsenal (35 weapons)
nodes.rationale: Melee, guns and 8 staffs; legendary weapons only sold by merchant for golden eggs, never dropped

nodes.label: Snap Headless Test Tool
nodes.rationale: Runs the game headless, saves frames as PNG; modes: perf, sk, story, glyphs, skweapons, hamster, mphost/mpclient; also icon generator

nodes.label: Soul Knight Mode
nodes.rationale: Roguelike dungeon run through two worlds (forest 0-1..0-5, factory catacombs 1-1..1-5) with its own 35 weapons, 2 weapon slots, no grenades, no health regen, stamina spent on shots

nodes.label: Stamina
nodes.rationale: 100 stamina spent on shots only in Soul Knight mode

nodes.label: Story Guns (21, four rarities)
nodes.rationale: Each class has a common, rare, epic and legendary gun; rarer guns have stronger tricks

nodes.label: Story Mode
nodes.rationale: 4 chapters x 20 levels, 8 bosses, night levels; every level lasts at least 3 minutes, boss appears at 1:15

nodes.label: Code-Synthesized Audio
nodes.rationale: Sound and music synthesized in code; WASAPI via NAudio on Windows, AudioTrack on Android

nodes.label: XOMJIK (Illia Martseniuk)
nodes.rationale: Creator, programming

nodes.label: Battle Coop (Boevoy Kuryatnik)
nodes.rationale: Cartoon top-down shooter for Windows and Android; fully offline with graphics, sound, fonts and saves built into the app

nodes.label: Project Layout
nodes.rationale: Shared code in src/Kuriatnyk (Game, Render, Audio, UI, Assets) with thin Desktop and Android launchers

nodes.label: Hit-Charged Ultimate
nodes.rationale: Ultimate charges from hits on enemies; each hero needs a different hit count, snipers the most (balances high per-hit damage)

nodes.label: Host-Run Match Model
nodes.rationale: The host runs the match and each player controls their own hero; clients receive world snapshots (MpSync.cs)

nodes.label: Fully Offline Design
nodes.rationale: All assets (graphics, sound, fonts, saves) are embedded so the game works without network; sound is synthesized in code rather than loaded from files
